title: What If the Moon Vanished Tonight?

scenes.text: What if the Moon vanished tonight? The first thing you'd notice isn't the dark.
It's the oceans. The Moon drives most of our tides, and the Sun alone would give less than half.
Tides would shrink on every coast. Shoreline animals that time their lives to them would struggle.
Hatchling sea turtles steer to the sea by moonlight, and moths navigate by it too.
Then the slow part. The Moon holds Earth's 23.5 degree tilt steady, so over eons the tilt would wobble.
Some places would see months of sun overhead, others almost none. Seasons would turn wild, for a very long time.

description:
What if the Moon vanished tonight?
Tides would fall to less than half their size, and over eons Earth's tilt could wobble.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Which would you miss most: the tides or the moonlight? Drop your own 'what if'.
